content.text: **Finding: deviation (MFN)** — Section 7.2 (p0027) imposes an open-ended most-favoured-nation obligation on us, requiring Redwood to give Silverline terms no less favourable than the best terms offered to any other technology supplier. With no product, duration or comparison limits, it fails the fallback and reaches walk-away territory; it also contradicts Section 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges no most-favoured-customer commitment was made. Redline validated: delete Section 7.2 in full (no Vendor-granted MFN in our favour is affected).
